dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mr. Brown, you look worried. Is everything OK?
dialogue.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn, juː ˈlʊk ˈwɜːrid. ɪz ˈɛvriθɪŋ oʊˈkeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Not really. When I got home last night, someone had broken into my apartment.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈriːli. wɛn aɪ ˈɡɑːt ˈhoʊm ˈlæst ˈnaɪt, ˈsʌmwʌn hæd ˈbroʊkən ˈɪntuː maɪ əˈpɑːrtmənt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh no! What did they take?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! ˈwʌt dɪd ðeɪ ˈteɪk?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: The burglar had taken my laptop and some cash.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈbɜːrɡlər hæd ˈteɪkən maɪ ˈlæptɑːp ənd sʌm ˈkæʃ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I had left a window open. I'm so angry with myself!
dialogue.reading: aɪ hæd ˈlɛft ə ˈwɪndoʊ ˈoʊpən. aɪm ˈsoʊ ˈæŋɡri wɪð maɪˈsɛlf!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, but when they arrived, the burglar had gone, of course.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt wɛn ðeɪ əˈraɪvd, ðə ˈbɜːrɡlər hæd ˈɡɔːn, əv ˈkɔːrs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's terrible. Did he take any other valuables?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtɛrəbəl. dɪd hiː ˈteɪk ˈɛni ˈʌðər ˈvæljuəbəlz?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, luckily. My passport was in my bag with me.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ˈlʌkəli. maɪ ˈpæspɔːrt wʌz ɪn maɪ ˈbæɡ wɪð miː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: There was a robbery near my apartment last month, too. Two men robbed a phone shop.
dialogue.reading: ðɛr wʌz ə ˈrɑːbəri ˈnɪr maɪ əˈpɑːrtmənt ˈlæst ˈmʌnθ, ˈtuː. ˈtuː ˈmɛn ˈrɑːbd ə ˈfoʊn ˈʃɑːp.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Bangkok is usually safe, but we all need to be careful.
dialogue.reading: ˈbæŋkɑːk ɪz ˈjuːʒuəli ˈseɪf, bʌt wiː ˈɔːl ˈniːd tə bi ˈkɛrfəl.
